URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/19/us-launches-new-iran-strikes-after-two-soldiers-killed-whats-the-latest
(WebFetch — Al Jazeera newsroom, 19 July 2026)

US strikes: eighth consecutive night of attacks (Saturday into Sunday, 19-20 July). CENTCOM
struck Iranian military coastal surveillance, air-defence facilities, maritime capabilities,
and missile/drone storage sites belonging to the IRGC.

CENTCOM statement: the strikes are "designed to further degrade Iran's ability to threaten
commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and swiftly punish Islamic Revolutionary Guard
Corps forces".

Iranian attacks:
- Jordan: two US soldiers killed in Friday strikes.
- Kuwait: large-scale drone attack on Camp al-Adiri ammunition depot and Ali Al Salem airbase.
- Bahrain: air-raid sirens activated in Manama and across the kingdom.

Official statements:
- President Trump: "We're never allowing Iran to have a nuclear weapon."
- Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei: warned the US would suffer "unforgettable lessons",
  saying Washington's MoU breaches showed Trump's signature was "utterly worthless and invalid".
- Major-General Ali Abdullahi (Khatam al-Anbiya): "Any aggression or barbarism will be met with
  a decisive and devastating response."

Diplomacy: ceasefire described as fragile and eroding amid ongoing strikes.
